audit.whatIsWrong: content win[0..6] = [Skill,Skill,Skill,Brand,Brand,Brand,Sona] but full phases[0..6].side = [Brand,Brand,Brand,Skill,Skill,Skill,Skill] — the two layers were an inverted mirror-image of each other on every row.
audit.why: Sear (Q) only stuns if the target is Ablaze from Pillar of Flame (W) first, so levels 1-3 are a genuine poke duel, not a Brand win; his mana-sustained W-Q spam and Pyroclasm (R) take over 4-6, then Sona's aura stacking outscales an immobile mage at two items — that is exactly what content's whys[] already say.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..6].side to match win[0..6] (no content edit needed, win[] was already correct) and rewrote each why to state the real mechanic instead of generic aura filler.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no real cooldown number.
audit.why: Sear (Q) is a stun that requires Ablaze from Pillar of Flame (W); Pyroclasm (R) governs 6+ — naming the setup requirement is the actual counterplay.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Ablaze-gates-Sear interaction (his stun is conditional, not free) never reached breakdown.trading or the dos/donts, only content.spikes.
audit.why: Dodging Pillar of Flame denies the stun entirely — that is the single highest-value piece of advice in this matchup and it was buried in content only.
